_说明: viewer3d.html?model=outpost 的清单（标准档 + 低档 glb）。坐标 = glTF（Y 朝上，米）。只画外观：下层城边的防卫军前沿哨所与外墙缺口处的反兽障碍带；外墙、荒野、支撑柱与中层底面（bg_*）只在成图里。位置与形制为仓库推断。

credit.zh: 自建模型；贴图 Poly Haven / ambientCG（CC0）
credit.en: Own model; textures Poly Haven / ambientCG (CC0)

desc.zh: 指挥所：两层集装箱模块，外挂楼梯与屋顶平台。
desc.en: Command post: two-storey containerised modules with an outside stair and roof deck.

desc.zh: 防御围墙：防爆筐与混凝土 T 形墙，沙袋掩体。
desc.en: Perimeter: Hesco barriers, concrete T-walls and sandbag positions.

desc.zh: 观察塔与探照灯，朝城外照。
desc.en: Observation tower with a searchlight aimed outward.

desc.zh: 南侧道闸与岗亭，北侧钢门上满是抓痕。
desc.en: South barrier and guard booth; the north steel gate is covered in gouges.

desc.zh: 无武装、无标识的装甲通用车。
反兽障碍带：钢刺猬、带刺混凝土墩与留着抓痕的钢板墙——防卫军守的是城外异兽的外围防线。
desc.en: Anti-beast barricade: steel hedgehogs, spiked concrete blocks and clawed steel plate walls; the Defense Force holds the outer line against beasts from beyond the city.

desc.zh: 外墙缺口：参差的断口与裸露钢筋，外面就是荒野。
desc.en: Breach in the outer city wall: jagged edges and exposed rebar, with the wilderness beyond.

desc.zh: 后勤：发电机、油囊、天线杆、伪装网与水箱。
desc.en: Support: generator, fuel bladder, antenna mast, camouflage net and water tanks.

desc.zh: 朝外与朝院内的投光灯。
desc.en: Floodlights facing outward and into the yard.

desc.zh: 碎石院子、混凝土车位、车辙与积水。
desc.en: Gravel yard, concrete pads, ruts and puddles.
